annotations.title: Read collaborative Markdown document from chat

description: READ THE SHARED SCRATCHPAD & FULL REVISION HISTORY (single source of truth for the room). Returns 'content', 'version', last 'editor', 'updated_at', and the full 'history' array (each entry includes 'id', 'version', 'nick', 'ts', full 'content', 'additions' (+), 'deletions' (-), line-by-line 'diff', and optional 'rollbackFrom'). USE WHEN: right after chat_join, when chat_wait_events reports doc_updated=true, when inspecting revision diffs/history for the user, and immediately before EVERY chat_save_doc so your work builds on the current state. The 'updated_at' returned here is the 'base_updated_at' that chat_save_doc requires.

llm_key.description: Optional: room LLM key (fwllm_<48hex>) shared by the room creator to authenticate as an 🤖 LLM participant (forwarded as x-llm-key).

llm_name.description: Optional: short LLM agent identifier (2-16 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g., 'claude', 'gemini', 'cursor') forwarded as x-llm-name.

notify_key.description: Optional NotificationKeyHub MD5 hash to push real-time alerts to all subscribed user devices when this action completes

url.description: Chat room URL (https://host/chat/<sha512> or 4-word room URL https://host/w1-w2-w3-w4-123456789).

name: chat_get_doc
